profile.Name: Mukai The Mountain
profile.Personality: A proud Shek warrior who deals with lawbreakers himself and looks down on humans.
profile.Backstory: An influential Shek warrior who took Esata's place as one of the Invincibles after she fell. He leads what remains of the Shek Kingdom from the small town of Squin.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Short, contemptuous orders; calls humans flatskins and vermin.
